selection_basis: SEDAR 100 final report (August 2026) is the latest detailed completed assessment located, with data through 2024 and numeric source tables available for source curation. NOAA has not posted an actual peer-review dissemination date and formal management adoption for advice remains unconfirmed; preserve SEDAR 100 values as report outputs, not as confirmed management advice. The source does not publish native catch-at-age or annual N-at-age/F-at-age arrays.
